answer: A datacenter or proxy pool hence cannot mint a farm in one epoch however much capital it holds, because each identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The thread cap is enforced at intake and echo reveals the per-origin counts. At most 3 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a terrace tag. That is 13 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
